subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land the focused fresh-session fallback now, or wait for the reattach-first recovery design tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-backed, but it intentionally preserves duplicate execution and possible duplicate delivery side effects after gateway acceptance, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Land focused mitigation now
options.body: Merge this PR as the narrow same-session collision fix and leave reattach-first behavior to the linked product issue.

options.title: Expand before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to turn this branch into a reattach-first layered recovery so accepted disconnects usually return the gateway run result instead of re-running locally.

options.title: Pause for product direction
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it only after maintainers decide that recook-first accepted-disconnect fallback should not ship.

recommendation.title: Land focused mitigation now
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the narrow same-session collision fix and leave reattach-first behavior to the linked product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the `openclaw agent` gateway dispatch and timeout behavior that this PR extends.
